items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 17 at 1:27PM EDT until October 17 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 35 mph.

* WHERE...Portions of Big Bend and Panhandle Florida.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT /7 PM CDT/ this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Frequent wind gusts forecast around 30-35 mph
will create dangerous conditions outdoors in the vulnerable areas
amidst ongoing hurricane recovery efforts. Elsewhere, winds may
result in large tree branches downed and localized power outages.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 17 at 3:07PM EDT until October 18 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and
seas 5 to 8 ft.

* WHERE...Offshore Gulf waters from the Walton-Okaloosa County
line to the Ochlockonee River from 20 to 60 nautical miles
out, Nearshore Gulf waters from the Ochlockonee River to the
Suwannee River out 20 nautical miles, Coastal waters from
Mexico Beach to Okaloosa Walton County Line FL out 20 NM,
Coastal waters from Mexico Beach to Apalachicola FL out 20 NM,
and Coastal Waters From Ochlockonee River to Apalachicola Fl
out to 20 Nm.

* WHEN...Until 8 AM EDT /7 AM CDT/ Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for severe conditions.
